notes: The UW–Madison page (https://research.wisc.edu/?p=57818) is a short news item dated 27 Jun 2024. It is not a funding notice. It states no cost, funding source, 6000 age or service cost, and it doesn't say whether the 6000 was retired. The only rationale is that the X Plus offers 'expanded capacity and lower consumable costs'. A search for .edu pages on 6000 end-of-service and for 2025-26 peer funding notices found no such notices; the site:.edu filter was not enforced. Search snippets for UWBC (2023 update, snippet only) say the 26B flow cell would roughly halve sequencing cost per Gb for large projects. I could not open that page (404). A second UW post (cgsi.wisc.edu, undated) says the 10B X lane costs $2,050 and is 30% cheaper than the older option. Other hits (Northwestern, Dana-Farber, Novogene, federal 6000 service contracts) are already known or are government maintenance sole-source notices. All the content found shows the driver is price and capacity, not end of life, but it is 2023-24 and not about residual tail users.
how_to_mine: Not recommended. If continued, use SAM.gov/govsignals sole-source notices for 6000 maintenance renewals, which show 6000 units still under paid service into 2026-27. Examples are the UK Contracts Finder notice dated 11 Feb 2026 (service term 18 Jan 2026 to 17 Jan 2027), NICHD, NIEHS, and CDC. Those could size the federal 6000 tail.

items.label: 1A
items.claim: A UK public notice shows a NovaSeq 6000 maintenance contract running Jan 2026 to Jan 2027, so some 6000s stay in paid service.
items.detail: The UK Contracts Finder notice, published 11 Feb 2026, covers 6000 maintenance from 18 Jan 2026 to 17 Jan 2027. NIH sole-source notices for 6000 service (NICHD to Feb 2026, NIEHS Bronze) show similar renewals. This is a snippet-level read of search results; I did not open the notice, and the buyer is not identified.
items.why_new: The exclusion list names no 6000 service-contract renewals in public procurement.

new_candidates.source: SAM.gov / govsignals sole-source notices for NovaSeq 6000 service agreements 2025-26
new_candidates.why: The count and timing of renewals would proxy the federal 6000 tail and the support the tail depends on.
